_comment: Per-gripper settings; see 'Adding a gripper' in grasp_matrix/README.md. Paths are relative to the gripper asset's default prim (articulation = where to look for the fingertip bodies). Axes are in the gripper's own frame. Optional: fingertips (the two pad body names, if they do not contain 'fingertip'), coupled_joints (joints driven with the same target as drive_joint), anchor_joint (a fixed root joint with no body0, which pins the base to the world origin; it is re-anchored to the gripper's root prim so the gripper can be placed), pad_shapes (for stepped fingertips: the collision shapes that touch the object, which define the pad). Measured geometry (opening, open/closed joint values, where the pads meet, fingertip standoff) comes from data/gripper_calibration.json, written by tools/calibrate_grippers.py. label, datasheet, source and notes are documentation only and do not affect results.

robotiq_hand_e.label: HAND-E
robotiq_hand_e.notes: Stepped fingertips: hull_1, near the base, reaches 6.6 mm further in than the flat pad face (hull_0, hull_2). Measured between hull_1 the opening is 36.8 mm; between the pad faces 49.6 mm, matching the datasheet. pad_shapes added 2026-11-09; earlier runs used the whole fingertip.

franka_hand.label: FRANKA
franka_hand.notes: Each finger has its own drive (no mimic joint), so both are driven. The fingers are stepped; only box_3 at the tip reaches the object, so it is the pad. The root joint pins the hand to the world origin, so it is re-anchored. No physics material: PhysX default friction.

onrobot_2fg7.label: 2FG7
onrobot_2fg7.notes: No datasheet opening: the 2FG7's gripping range depends on how its fingertips are mounted (38 mm stroke).
